item.title: The Global Consequences of Strait of Hormuz Closure
item.description: Three weeks into the campaign of US and Israeli airstrikes against Iran and attention has shifted to the Strait of Hormuz and the closure of this vital waterway.The Strait of Hormuz is 39 km wide at its narrowest point, but this does not fully capture how constrained transit is. The designated shipping lanes are only about 3.7 km wide in each direction. Through these waters pass about 20 percent of global oil consumption and roughly one-third of all seaborne oil trade, much of it destined for As

item.title: Joe Kent Never Should Have Had This Job
item.description: Joe Kent has resigned as director of the National Counterterrorism Center. He should never have had the job to begin with. Kent explained in his resignation letter that he believes Iran posed “no imminent threat to our nation” and that Israel with the help of Israel’s powerful “lobby” is behind the United States “starting” the war.

item.title: Kent, NATO, Orbán, and Iran
item.description: On What Really Matters, Walter Russell Mead discusses Joe Kent’s resignation, Trump’s frustration with NATO’s refusal to help in the Gulf, JD Vance’s show of support for Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán, and the state of the war in Iran.

item.title: Iran: The Kharg Fantasy and How This Ends
item.description: On China Talk, Patrick Cronin examines the risks and strategic flaws behind a potential US move to seize Kharg Island, and what victory may look like for Iran. The discussion explores global energy disruption, naval strain, counterterrorism challenges, and political controversies shaping U.S. policy.

item.title: Trump Praises Japan, Slams NATO Over Iran: Takaichi Navigates Hormuz Pressure
item.description: On Taiwan Talks, Patrick Cronin discusses Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi Sanae’s high-stakes visit to Washington and examines Japan’s diplomatic challenge, US alliance dynamics, and what it means for Taiwan and the Indo-Pacific.

item.title: The Iran War’s Asian Tail Winds
item.description: Patrick Cronin appears on the Defense & Aerospace Report to discuss the United States-Israel war on Iran as the conflict enters its third week, as energy markets are shaken by strikes on Gulf energy infrastructure and a backup of ships unwilling to brave the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Iran is a Serious Threat to the World
item.description: On Fox News, Walter Russell Mead discusses the evolving state of the United States–Israel war in Iran as it enters its fourth week. He notes the US’s firm commitment to preventing nuclear proliferation, which remains central, Europe's support or resistance to the war, and more.
